items.title: 9.1 Nizam-e-hazma (digestive system) ki banawat aur kaam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 9.1, printed pages 202-212.

blocks.text: Hazma (digestion) woh amal hai jis se jism khoorak ko chhote, jazb hone ke qabil (absorbable) ajza mein torta hai. Yeh khoorak ko tawanai (energy) aur nashonuma (growth), marammat (repair) aur jism ke kaamon ko qaim rakhne ke liye darkar kham mawad mein badalne ke liye nihayat aham hai; yeh mudafati nizam (immune system) ko sahara deta, zaroori ghizai ajza (nutrients) faraham karta aur majmui sehat yaqeeni banata hai. Moassar hazma nutrients ki kami rokta, metabolism ko sahara deta aur tawanai ki satah qaim rakhta hai, jo zindagi ke liye lazmi hai.

Insani nizam-e-hazma (digestive system) gastrointestinal (GI) tract aur madadgar (accessory) hazmi aza (organs) par mushtamil hai. GI tract ek musalsal nali hai jo munh se maqad (anus) tak phaili hai: oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, maida (stomach), chhoti aant (small intestine) aur bari aant (large intestine). Accessory hazmi aza salivary glands, jigar (liver), pitta ki thaili (gallbladder) aur labloba (pancreas) hain.

blocks.alt: Aant ka nali ke taur par khaaka: teen salivary glands wali oral cavity, pharynx, seedha oesophagus, J ki shakal ka maida, kundli-dar chhoti aant aur frame ki shakal ki bari aant jis mein cecum aur appendix, rectum aur anus par khatm. Jigar, gallbladder aur pancreas maide ke pehlu mein, un ki naliyan duodenum se jurti hain.
blocks.caption: Gastrointestinal tract aur accessory aza (Figures 9.1, 9.2 aur 9.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Khoorak oral cavity se, jahan salivary glands ke teen jore laab (saliva) dalte hain, pharynx aur 25 cm ke oesophagus se guzar kar J ki shakal ke maide tak jati hai, phir qareeb 6 metre chhoti aant (duodenum, jejunum, ileum) mein jahan hazma mukammal aur khoorak jazb hoti hai, aur aakhir mein aakhri metre, bari aant (cecum apne baqiyati appendix ke saath, ascending, transverse aur descending colon, rectum aur anus), jo pani, namak aur vitamin K jazb karti hai. Jigar bile banata hai, gallbladder use rakhta hai, aur pancreas pancreatic juice banata hai; un ki naliyan mil kar duodenum mein khulti hain. Yeh khaaka hai, anatomical tasveer nahin.

blocks.text: Oral cavity (munh ka khala)

Oral cavity munh ke khulne ke foran baad ka khala (cavity) hai. Hont (lips) bohat zyada khoon ki naliyon wale skeletal muscle tissue ke bane hain jin mein bohat se hissi asaab ke sire (sensory nerve endings) hain; yeh chabate waqt khoorak ko rokne mein madad dete hain aur awaz ki tabdeeli (phonation) mein bhi kirdar ada karte hain. Oral cavity teen aham kaam karti hai.

items: Khoorak ka intikhab (selection): azlati zaban (muscular tongue) apne zaiqa ke ghunchon (taste buds) se khoorak ke intikhab mein kirdar ada karti hai. Khoorak oral cavity mein aati hai to chakhi aur mehsoos ki jati hai; agar zaiqa ya boo na-gawar ho, ya haddi ya mitti jaisi sakht cheezein maujood hon, to use radd kar diya jata hai. Boo aur nazar ke hawas bhi khoorak ke intikhab mein hissa lete hain.

Mechanical hazma: li hui khoorak daanton se chabane (mastication) mein tabee taur par tori jati hai. Chabana khoorak ko chhote, qaboo mein aane wale tukron mein badalta hai, jo enzyme ke amal ke liye satahi raqba (surface area) barhata hai.

Kimiyai (chemical) hazma: chabane ke dauran salivary glands apni rutubat, laab (saliva), oral cavity mein dalte hain, aur talu (palate), zaban aur gaal chabai hui khoorak ko us se milane mein madad karte hain.

blocks.text: Salivary glands ke teen jore hain: zaban ke neeche sublingual glands, jabron ke peeche submaxillary glands, aur kanon ke samne parotid glands. Laab mein pani aur mucus hote hain jo khoorak ko geela aur chikna karte hain, bicarbonate ions jo oral cavity mein kimiyai maddon ko buffer karte hain, aur thiocyanate ions jo jarasim (microorganisms) ko maarte hain. Taza laab alkaline (pH 8) hota hai magar jaldi CO2 kho kar pH 6 par aa jata hai. Is mein enzyme salivary amylase bhi hai, jo polysaccharides starch aur glycogen ko juzvi taur par disaccharide maltose mein hazam karta hai. Oral cavity ke mechanical aur chemical amal ke baad khoorak ek chhota geela lothra ban jati hai jise bolus kehte hain.
Pharynx aur nigalna (swallowing)

Pharynx munh ke peeche ka khala aur hazmi aur tanaffusi (respiratory) raston ka mushtarak rasta hai. Bolus munh ke peeche dhakela jata aur pharynx se nigla jata hai. Nigalne ke dauran zaban munh ki chhat ke khilaf oopar aur peeche harkat karti hai, jo bolus ko oral cavity ke peeche dhakelti hai, aur narm talu (soft palate) pharynx ki pichli deewar ke khilaf uthta hai; yeh harkatein naak ke khale (nasal cavity) aur pharynx ke darmiyan rasta band kar deti hain. Isi waqt larynx oopar harkat karta hai, jis se epiglottis, cartilage ka ek parda (flap), neeche hota aur trachea ka munh band kar deta hai. Is tarah bolus trachea ke oopar se guzar kar oesophagus mein dakhil hota hai.

blocks.title: Pehle ikhtiyari, phir khud-ba-khud
blocks.text: Nigalne ke amal ki shuruat ikhtiyari (voluntary) hai, magar khoorak munh ke peeche pohnch jaye to nigalna khud-ba-khud (automatic) ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Ek hi raston ke do panels: nasal cavity, oral cavity, pharynx, trachea aur oesophagus jure hue boxes ke taur par. Nigalne se pehle soft palate neeche latka hai aur epiglottis khara hai, naak aur trachea khule hain. Nigalne ke dauran soft palate uth kar nasal cavity band karta hai, epiglottis trachea par chapta leta hai, aur ek dashed surkh rasta bolus ko zaban se oesophagus mein le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Nigalne se pehle aur dauran ke raste (Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Pharynx khoorak aur hawa mein mushtarak hai, is liye do parde is ki hifazat karte hain. Nigalne se pehle soft palate neeche latka aur epiglottis oopar hai: naak pharynx ki taraf khuli aur trachea hawa ke liye khuli hai. Jab zaban bolus ko peeche dhakelti hai, soft palate pharynx ki pichli deewar ke khilaf uth kar naak ka rasta band karta hai, aur larynx uthta hai taake epiglottis trachea par neeche ho jaye. Is liye bolus band trachea ke oopar se oesophagus mein jata hai. Nigalna ikhtiyari shuru hota aur phir khud-ba-khud ho jata hai.

blocks.text: Oesophagus (khoorak ki nali)

Nigle jane ke baad khoorak oesophagus mein dakhil hoti hai, woh nali jo pharynx ko maide se jorti hai; laab ka hazmi amal is mein jari rehta hai. Balig (adult) mein oesophagus qareeb 25 cm lamba hai aur us ka nichla sira maide mein khulta hai. Khoorak peristalsis se neeche maide tak jati hai. Khoorak ka maide mein dakhla nichle oesophageal sphincter ya cardiac sphincter se qaboo hota hai, jo khoorak ke dabao ke jawab mein khulta hai aur maide ke mawad ko oesophagus mein wapas aane se rokta hai.
Alimentary canal ki harkat (motility)

items: Peristalsis alimentary canal ki deewaron ke smooth muscles mein sukarne (contraction) ki lehron ka ba-qaida silsila hai. Yeh khoorak ko oesophagus aur canal ke doosre hisson mein aage dhakelta hai.

Segmentation: chhoti aur bari aant mein smooth muscle ke halqe (rings) bhi hain jo baar baar sukarte aur dheele hote hain, aur ek hi jagah aage-peeche harkat paida karte hain. Yeh khoorak ko hazmi rutubaat se milati aur jazb ki karkardagi barhati hai.

blocks.text: Kabhi kabhar peristaltic harkatein ulat jati hain, antiperistalsis mein, jo khoorak ko aanton se wapas maide aur oral cavity mein dhakelti hain aur qai (vomiting) ka sabab banti hain. Is ke bar-aks bhook ke sukar (hunger contractions) khoon mein kam glucose se shuru hone wali peristaltic harkatein hain, jo bhook ki tees (hunger pangs) ka na-khushgawar ehsaas paida karti hain.

blocks.title: Seene ki jalan (heartburn)
blocks.text: Kabhi tezabi chyme maide se wapas oesophagus mein aa jata hai. Yeh seene mein dardnak jalan ka sabab banta hai, jise pyrosis ya heartburn kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Peristalsis: ek bhoore bolus ke peeche dabi hui nali, teer use aage dhakelta dikhata hai. Segmentation: kai jagah dabi nali jis mein chhote bolus aur dono taraf teer. Oesophagus: pharynx se maide tak nali jis ki bunyad par surkh cardiac sphincter, peristalsis ke liye neeche khakistari teer aur antiperistalsis ke liye oopar dashed surkh teer.
blocks.caption: Peristalsis, segmentation aur oesophagus (Figures 9.4 aur 9.5 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Peristalsis mein smooth muscle bolus ke peeche sukarta aur aage dheela hota hai, to ek lehr khoorak ko oesophagus se aage dhakelti hai. Segmentation mein aanton ke muscle ke halqe ek hi jagah sukarte aur dheele hote hain, mawad ko aage-peeche hila kar hazmi rutubaat se milate aur jazb behtar karte hain. 25 cm ka oesophagus bolus ko cardiac sphincter se maide tak pohnchata hai, jo khoorak ke dabao se khulta aur wapsi rokta hai; ulti lehr, antiperistalsis, qai ka sabab banti hai, aur tezabi chyme ki wapsi seene ki jalan.

blocks.text: Maida (stomach)

Maida ek lachakdar, azlati, J ki shakal ka thaila hai jo oesophagus ke baad aur duodenum se pehle, pait ke khale (abdominal cavity) ki baen taraf diaphragm ke theek neeche hai. Is ke teen hisse hain: oesophagus ke foran baad cardiac hissa, cardiac hisse ke ek taraf fundus, aur cardiac hisse ke neeche pyloric hissa. Cardiac sphincter tab khulta hai jab oesophagus se neeche aati peristaltic sukar ki lehr us tak pohnchti hai, aur khoorak ko maide mein jane deta hai.
Maide mein mechanical hazma

Maide ki deewar alimentary canal ke doosre hisson jaisi tahon ki bani hai: sab se bahar serosa, darmiyan mein smooth muscle ki tah, aur andar ki do tahein, submucosa aur mucosa. Maide mein muscle ki teen tahein hain, bairooni tooli (longitudinal), darmiyani gol (circular) aur andarooni tirchi (oblique). Azlati deewarein zor se sukarti hain, khoorak ko mathti (mechanical hazma) aur maide ki rutubaat se milati hain; yeh sukar itni garmi bhi paida karte hain ke thos charbi (fats) pighal jaye.
Maide mein chemical hazma

Maide ki mucosa mein be-shumar nali-numa gastric glands hain, jo gehre garhon, gastric pits, ke zariye mucosa mein khulte hain. Har gland mein epithelial cells aur teen qism ke rutubat banane wale (secretory) cells hain.

items: Mucous cells mucus banate hain, ek gaarhi rutubat jo maide ke andar ko dhanpti aur use HCl aur hazmi enzymes se bachati hai.
Parietal (oxyntic) cells hydrochloric acid banate hain, jo maide ke mawad ka pH qareeb 2 se 3 kar deta hai. HCl khoorak ko narm bhi karta hai, pepsinogen ko faal karta aur jarasim maarta hai.
Chief cells enzyme pepsinogen banate hain.

blocks.text: Gastric glands ki tamam rutubaat mil kar gastric juice hain. Bolus maide mein aata hai to glands gastric juice banate hain; HCl ke H+ ions pepsinogen ko pepsin mein faal karte hain, aur pepsin proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein torne ka amal tez karta hai. Khane ke teen se chaar ghante baad maide ka mawad kafi mil chuka hota hai aur ek neem-mai (semi-liquid) tezabi lothra hota hai jise chyme kehte hain. Pyloric sphincter chyme ke chhoti aant mein chhorne ko qaboo karta hai.

blocks.title: Shir-khwaron (infants) mein rennin
blocks.text: Shir-khwaron ke gastric juice mein enzyme rennin bari miqdar mein hota hai, jo doodh ke proteins ko jamata aur doodh ke chhoti aant mein jane mein takheer karta hai, taake doosre enzymes ko doodh ke proteins hazam karne ka waqt mile.

blocks.title: Maida apni hifazat kaise karta hai
blocks.text: Agar koi hifazat na ho to maide ki mucosa tezab aur pepsin se kharab ho jaye. Is ki hifazat do tarah hoti hai: gaarhe mucus se, aur bicarbonate se, jo tezab ko be-asar (neutralise) karta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: J ki shakal ka maida jis mein oesophagus cardiac sphincter se dakhil hota hai, fundus, cardiac hissa, body aur pyloric hissa label hain, aur pyloric sphincter duodenum ki taraf. Daen: deewar ki tahon ka dher serosa se teen muscle tahon se ho kar submucosa aur mucosa tak, aur ek nali-numa gastric gland jo pit par khulta hai, neele mucous cells, gulabi parietal cells aur sabz chief cells ke saath.
blocks.caption: Maida, us ki deewar aur ek gastric gland (Figure 9.6 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Maida do sphincters ke darmiyan cardiac, fundic aur pyloric hisson wala J ki shakal ka thaila hai. Is ki deewar mein serosa, teen muscle tahein (longitudinal, circular aur oblique) jo khoorak mathti aur use itna garam karti hain ke charbi pighle, submucosa aur gastric glands se bhari mucosa hai. Har gland mein mucous cells hifazati mucus banate hain, parietal cells HCl banate hain jo pH qareeb 2 se 3 karta, khoorak narm karta, jarasim maarta aur pepsinogen faal karta hai, aur chief cells pepsinogen banate hain jise HCl pepsin mein badalta hai jo proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein kaat'ta hai. Teen se chaar ghante baad yeh mixture chyme hai.

blocks.text: Gastric juice ki rutubat ka intizam (regulation)

Gastric juice ki rutubat asabi nizam (nervous system) aur hormones dono se qaboo hoti hai. Khoorak ki boo, nazar ya khayal ke radd-e-amal mein dimagh ka medulla gastric glands ko thori miqdar mein gastric juice banane ka paigham bhejta hai. Khoorak pohnchti hai to maide ka phailna (distension) aur us ke mawad ke pH ka girna zyada rutubat aur zordar sukar ko tehreek dete hain. Khoorak mein proteins ki maujoodgi mucosa ke khaas endocrine cells ko hormone gastrin chhorne par ubharti hai, jo khoon ke zariye gastric glands tak jata hai aur unhen zyada gastric juice banane aur chhorne par ubharta hai. Jab khoorak maide se chhoti aant mein jati hai to hormone somatostatin hydrochloric acid ka nikalna rok deta hai.
Chhoti aant (small intestine)

Chhoti aant alimentary canal ka sab se lamba hissa hai, jo maide ke baad shuru aur bari aant par khatm hoti hai; balig mein yeh qareeb 2 se 3 cm chauri aur 6 m lambi hai. Yeh na sirf har qism ki khoorak ke aakhri hazme ki balke hazam shuda khoorak ke khoon aur lymph mein jazb ki bhi zimmedar hai. Is ke teen hisse hain: duodenum, jejunum aur ileum.
Duodenum

Pehle 20 se 25 cm duodenum hain, jo khoorak ke hazme se taalluq rakhta hai. Is mein glands hain jo bicarbonate wali alkaline rutubat banate hain, aur is mein do bari rutubaat dali jati hain: pancreatic juice aur bile. Pancreatic juice, pancreas ki rutubat, apne bicarbonate ki wajah se halki alkaline (pH 8) hai aur chyme ki tezabiyat ko be-asar karti hai. Is ke aham enzymes neeche diye gaye hain.

items: Pancreatic amylase polysaccharides ko maltose aur yahan tak ke glucose mein hazam karta hai.
Trypsinogen ghair-faal shakal mein nikalta hai; duodenum ki deewaron se nikla enzyme enterokinase use trypsin mein faal karta hai, jo proteins ko polypeptides mein hazam karta hai.
Chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase proteins ko chhote peptides aur phir amino acids mein hazam karte hain.
Pancreatic lipase lipids ko glycerol aur fatty acids mein hazam karta hai.
Pancreatic nucleases DNA aur RNA ko nucleotides mein hazam karte hain.

blocks.text: Bile jigar ki rutubat hai, jo nikalne se pehle gallbladder mein rakhi jati hai. Is mein namak (salts) hain jo charbi ko emulsify karte hain, use chhote qatron (emulsion) mein torte hain jo charbi hazam karne wale enzymes ke moassar amal ke liye bara satahi raqba dete hain.

blocks.title: Bile kyun chahiye, aur yarqan (jaundice)
blocks.text: Charbi pani mein hal nahin hoti, is liye pancreatic juice ka lipase us par asani se hamla nahin kar sakta. Bile ke namak detergent molecules ki tarah kaam karte hain: woh charbi ko qatron mein torte aur qatron ko ek doosre se alag rakhte hain. Agar bile ke rang (pigments) ko hazmi raste se nikalne se roka jaye to woh khoon mein jama ho sakte hain, jo yarqan (jaundice) ki kaifiyat ka sabab banta hai.
Jejunum aur ileum

Jejunum, 2.4 metre lamba, duodenum ke baad aata hai, aur ileum, aakhri teen-panjum aur qareeb 3.5 metre lamba, chhoti aant mukammal karta hai. Yeh hisse baqi hazma aur khoorak ka jazb karte hain. In ki deewaron mein glands hain jo intestinal juice banate hain, jis ke enzymes table mein diye hain. In enzymes ke amal ke baad chyme ek alkaline emulsion mein badal jata hai jise chyle kehte hain.
Hazam shuda khoorak aur pani ka jazb (absorption)

Hazam shuda khoorak, pani aur hal shuda minerals ka jazb jejunum aur ileum mein hota hai. In ki andarooni deewar mein bari gol silwatein (circular folds) hain jin par be-shumar ungli-numa ubhaar hain jinhen villi kehte hain, is liye andarooni satah makhmali (velvety) lagti hai. Har villus mein khoon ki capillaries aur lymphatic nizam ki ek nali, lacteal, bharpoor taur par maujood hain, sab ek cell moti epithelium se dhaki. Epithelial cells par be-shumar cytoplasmic ubhaar, microvilli, hote hain. Villi aur microvilli ki wajah se jazb ka kul satahi raqba ghair-mamooli taur par bara ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: aant ki deewar ki patti jis ki silwaton par chhote ungli-numa villi, aur microvilli se bhari cell ki satah ka inset. Darmiyan: ek lamba villus jis mein narangi ek-cell epithelium, sabz markazi lacteal aur andar ghoomti surkh aur neeli capillaries. Daen: do box jo sugars aur amino acids ke capillaries se jigar tak, aur fatty acids aur glycerol ke lacteal se khoon tak raste bayan karte hain.
blocks.caption: Aant ki deewar, ek villus aur jazb ke raste (Figure 9.7 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Jejunum aur ileum ki gol silwaton par villi hain, aur villus ke har epithelial cell par microvilli, jo mil kar jazb ki satah bohat bari banate hain. Har villus ke andar khoon ki capillaries aur ek markazi lacteal hain. Sada sugars aur amino acids diffusion ya active transport se epithelial cells mein aate aur capillaries mein jate hain, jo mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo jigar tak jati hai; jigar zaid ko glycogen aur proteins ke taur par rakhta aur zaroori miqdar hepatic vein se dil tak bhejta hai. Fatty acids aur glycerol passive taur par aate hain, dobara triglycerides bante hain, protein se dhak kar chylomicrons banate hain, aur lacteal, thoracic lymphatic duct aur phir khoon mein jate hain, jahan plasma ke enzymes chylomicrons ko wapas charbi mein torte hain.

items: Sada sugars aur amino acids: glucose aur amino acids diffusion ya active transport se villi ke epithelial cells mein jazb hote aur wahan se khoon ki capillaries mein jate hain, jo mil kar hepatic portal vein banati hain jo unhen jigar tak le jati hai. Jigar zaid glucose aur amino acids ko glycogen aur proteins ke taur par rakhta hai, aur zaroori miqdarein jigar se hepatic vein ke zariye dil tak jati hain.

Fatty acids aur glycerol: charbi ke hazme ki paidawar passive transport se epithelial cells mein jazb hoti hai, jahan woh dobara mil kar triglycerides banti hai. Triglycerides proteins se dhak kar chhote qatre, chylomicrons, banate hain, jo lacteals mein jate, thoracic lymphatic duct mein pohnchte aur wahan se khoon mein jate hain. Khoon ke plasma mein enzymes hain jo chylomicrons ko wapas charbi aur proteins mein torte hain; charbi aakhir mein fatty acids aur glycerol mein tooti aur jism ke cells mein dakhil hoti hai.

blocks.text: Bari aant (large intestine)

Bari aant alimentary canal ka aakhri hissa hai, chhoti aant se bohat chhoti aur raste ke qareeb aakhri metre par mushtamil. Yeh lumen se pani, namak aur vitamin K khoon mein jazb karti hai. Yeh kundli-dar nahin aur is ki andarooni satah par villi nahin. Is ke teen hisse hain.

items: Cecum: ileum aur colon ke darmiyan bari aant se nikla ek band thaila. Is ke band sire se ek ungli-numa ubhaar, vermiform appendix, nikalta hai, jo insani nizam-e-hazma mein koi kaam nahin karta aur baqiyati (vestigial) hai.

Colon: cecum ke baad, jis ki ek ascending, ek transverse aur ek descending shakh hai. Is ka asal kaam alimentary canal se pani jazb karna hai; jaise pani jazb hota hai, baqi mawad zyada thos hota jata hai. Yeh fuzla, faeces, bari tadaad mein bacteria, na-qabil-e-hazm nabati reshon (fibres) jaise cellulose, doosri ghair-hazam-shuda khoorak, jhari hui mucosal cells, bile ke rangon aur pani par mushtamil hai.

Rectum: bari aant ka aakhri hissa, jahan faeces aarzi taur par rakhe jate hain. Yeh anus se bahar khulta hai, jis ke gird do sphincters hain: smooth muscle ka andarooni sphincter aur dhaaridar (striated) muscle ka bairooni. Jab rectum faeces se bhar jata hai to defecation reflex paida hota hai; yeh baligon mein shaoori taur par roka jata hai magar shir-khwaron mein ghair-ikhtiyari hai, aur nashonuma ke dauran bachcha ise ikhtiyari qaboo mein lana seekhta hai.

blocks.title: Appendicitis
blocks.text: Appendicitis appendix ki soozish (inflammation) hai, aam taur par bacterial infection se. Mutasira appendix ko surgery se nikalna zaroori hai, warna yeh phat sakta hai aur soozish pait ki poori jhilli mein phail sakti hai. Appendix ka surgery se nikalna appendicectomy hai.

Bohat se bacteria, maslan E. coli, colon mein rehte aur faal taur par taqseem hote hain. Apne metabolism ke dauran yeh amino acids aur vitamin K banate hain, jo khoon ke jamne (coagulation) ke liye zaroori hai aur bari aant se khoon mein jazb hota hai.
Ikhraj (egestion) ka qaboo

Shir-khwaron mein ikhraj ka ghair-ikhtiyari reflex aur baligon mein ikhtiyari qaboo asabi aur azlati nashonuma ke do marhale hain. Shir-khwaron mein ikhraj spinal cord ke zariye hone wala ghair-ikhtiyari reflex hai: rectum ka phailna andarooni anal sphincter ke khud-ba-khud dheele hone aur fuzle ke ikhraj ko shuru karta hai, kyunke ikhtiyari qaboo ke zimmedar dimagh ke oonche markaz abhi poori tarah nahin bane. Baligon mein cerebral cortex ke pakne ke saath ikhraj ikhtiyari ho jata hai, jo bairooni anal sphincter ke shaoori intizam se defecation mein takheer ya shuruat ki ijazat deta hai. Yeh tabdeeli reflex raston ke shaoori qaboo se milne ki akkasi karti hai, jo samaji aur maholiyati taqazon ke mutabiq dhalti hai.
Accessory hazmi aza

items: Jigar aur gallbladder: jigar bile banata hai, jo charbi ke hazme ke liye lazmi hai kyunke yeh charbi ko emulsify karta hai. Jigar chhoti aant se jazb shuda nutrients ko process bhi karta hai, nuqsan-deh maddon ko be-zarar (detoxify) karta, proteins banata aur tawanai ke liye glycogen rakhta hai. Gallbladder bile ko rakhta aur gaarha karta hai; khoorak chhoti aant mein aati hai to yeh bile duct se bile chhorta hai.

Pancreas: maide ke theek ventral ek bara gland jis ke exocrine aur endocrine hisse hain. Exocrine (nali wala) hissa pancreatic juice ko pancreatic duct mein dalta hai, jo jigar se aane wali common bile duct se mil kar duodenum mein dakhil hoti hai; juice mein khoorak ke tamam girohon ke enzymes hain, khaas kar trypsin, chymotrypsin, lipases, amylases aur nucleases. Endocrine (be-nali) hissa hormones insulin aur glucagon ko extracellular fluid mein dalta hai, jahan se woh qareebi capillaries mein diffuse hote hain.

blocks.title: Pitte ki pathri (gall stones)
blocks.text: Jigar se nikla cholesterol gallbladder mein jam kar pitte ki pathri (gall stones) bana sakta hai, jo bile ke nikalne ko rok sakti hai.
Pancreas aur jigar ki rutubaat ka hormonal qaboo

Pancreas aur jigar se rutubaat ka nikalna bhi hormones se qaboo hota hai. Jab chyme maide se duodenum mein dakhil hota hai to us ki tezabiyat duodenum ki deewaron ko hormone secretin chhorne par ubharti hai. Isi tarah chyme mein juzvi taur par hazam shuda proteins aur charbi duodenum ki deewaron ko ek aur hormone, cholecystokinin (CCK), banane par ubharte hain. Dono hormones pancreas ko pancreatic juice aur gallbladder ko bile chhorne par ubharte hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisson ka flowchart. Oopar: boxes ki chaar qatarein jo khoorak ki nazar ya boo ka medulla ke zariye amal, maide ka phailna aur pH ka girna, proteins se khoon ke zariye gastrin ka nikalna, aur maide se khoorak ke jane par somatostatin dikhati hain, har ek gastric glands par khatm. Neeche: tezabi chyme se secretin aur juzvi hazam shuda proteins aur charbi se CCK ka nikalna, dono teer pancreas aur gallbladder par milte hain.
blocks.caption: Gastric juice, pancreatic juice aur bile kaise qaboo hote hain (is topic ke liye asal chart; kitab mein yahan koi figure nahin).
blocks.long_description: Gastric juice asabi qaboo mein hai, medulla khoorak ki nazar, boo ya khayal par thori rutubat ka aur bhare maide ka phailna aur tezabiyat zyada ka hukm deti hai, aur hormonal qaboo mein bhi, mucosa ke endocrine cells ka gastrin proteins aane par rutubat barhata aur somatostatin khoorak ke aage jane par HCl rokta hai. Duodenum mein chyme ki tezabiyat secretin aur us ke juzvi hazam shuda proteins aur charbi cholecystokinin chhorte hain; dono hormones pancreas se pancreatic juice aur gallbladder se bile nikalwate hain.

blocks.text: Jigar ka zakheere aur metabolism ka kirdar

Jigar khoorak ke zaid nutrients rakhta hai aur jab jism ko tawanai ya tameeri mawad chahiye to unhen chhorta hai: glycogen ke taur par rakha glucose, vitamins jaise A, D, B12 aur K, minerals jaise iron aur copper, aur charbi aur charbi mein hal hone wale maddey. Yeh metabolism mein bhi markazi kirdar ada karta hai, maddon ko torta, banata aur badalta hai. Yeh zaid glucose ko glycogen mein aur zaroorat par wapas badalta hai; tawanai ke liye charbi torta aur cholesterol aur lipoproteins banata hai; amino acids badalta aur nuqsan-deh ammonia ko urea mein badal kar hata deta hai, jo peshab mein kharij hota hai; khoon se zehreele maddey (toxins), dawaein aur alcohol torta aur hata deta hai; aur hormones ko torne aur qaboo karne mein madad karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ki bile duct pitte ki pathri se band hai. Charbi ke hazme, jild aur pancreatic juice par asar ki peshgoi karein, har ek ki wajah ke saath.
blocks.explanation: Bile ke namak ke baghair duodenum mein charbi emulsify nahin hoti, to pancreatic lipase us par asani se hamla nahin kar sakta aur charbi ka hazma girta hai. Jo bile ke rang nikal nahin sakte woh khoon mein jama ho kar yarqan (jaundice) paida karte hain. Pancreatic juice phir bhi nikalta hai, kyunke duodenum ke secretin aur CCK pancreas par pancreatic duct ke zariye amal karte hain, jo duodenum ke qareeb common bile duct se milne tak alag hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: GI tract munh se anus tak chalti hai (oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, maida, chhoti aant, bari aant); salivary glands, jigar, gallbladder aur pancreas accessory aza hain.

Munh: zaiqe se intikhab, chabana, aur laab (pani, mucus, bicarbonate, thiocyanate, starch ko maltose banane wala salivary amylase) bolus banate hain. Nigalna soft palate se naak ka rasta aur epiglottis se trachea band karta hai; peristalsis khoorak aage le jati, segmentation milati hai.

Maida: teen muscle tahein mathti hain; gastric glands (mucous, parietal, chief cells) mucus, HCl aur pepsinogen dete hain; pepsin polypeptides banata hai; chyme pyloric sphincter se nikalta hai. Rutubat medulla, phailne aur pH, gastrin aur somatostatin se qaboo hoti hai.

Chhoti aant: duodenum pancreatic juice (amylase, trypsin, chymotrypsin, carboxypeptidase, lipase, nucleases) aur bile leta hai; jejunum aur ileum intestinal juice jorte aur villi aur microvilli se jazb karte hain, sugars aur amino acids capillaries aur hepatic portal vein mein, charbi chylomicrons ke taur par lacteals mein.
Bari aant (cecum aur appendix, colon, rectum) pani, namak aur vitamin K jazb aur faeces zakheera karti hai; defecation reflex shir-khwaron mein ghair-ikhtiyari aur baligon mein ikhtiyari hai.

Jigar bile banata, glycogen, vitamins aur minerals rakhta, urea banata aur detoxify karta hai; gallbladder bile rakhta hai; pancreas exocrine (juice) aur endocrine (insulin, glucagon) hai. Duodenum ke secretin aur CCK pancreatic juice aur bile nikalwate hain.
